name: Conflict Probe v2 Smoke
description: Representative smoke-test workflow for Phase 03 prompt confusion. Publishes a small stratified subset of conflict_probe_examples_v2 with one train and one test lexical example per family x pressure x setting bucket.

source.sql: WITH stratified AS ( SELECT src.*, row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY strategy_family, environment_pressure_bucket, setting_bucket, lexical_split ORDER BY example_id ) AS smoke_rank FROM conflict_probe_examples_v2 src ), sampled AS ( SELECT * FROM stratified WHERE smoke_rank = 1 ) , ranked AS ( SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY example_id) AS log_id, sampled.* FROM sampled ) SELECT * FROM ranked
